assertions.source: (3q²−1)/(2q²) − (1 + ℏ_q − ℏ_q²/2) with ℏ_q = 1 − 1/q at 80 dps; the docstring's stated truncation identity, checked against the ℏ_q route main() already built and never read

assertions.name: em_shape_h0_truncation_is_unity
assertions.source: |(3q²−1)/(2q²) − 1| at q = 1+1e-40 = 1.0e-40; the h⁰ truncation returns the bare (α_em/π) unchanged, which is why the open item as posed is circular

assertions.name: em_shape_departure_from_unity_at_q0
assertions.source: (3q²−1)/(2q²) − 1 at q_0; nonzero, so the h⁰ truncation discards real q-dependence rather than the shape being flat

description: Item B of PR #1654: scaffolds the Bring-zero-mode derivation of the bare per-block (α_em/π) at the sign-block of H_3. Identifies the open question is NOT 'derive α_em/π from Bring' (it's the standard QED bubble) but 'derive why EM couples to sign block'.

data.verdict: The 'Bring zero-mode derivation of bare per-block (α_em/π)' open item is structurally CIRCULAR as currently posed: the (α_em/π) IS the standard QED 1-loop coupling, not a Bring-specific derivation. The non-trivial derivation is WHY EM couples to the sign Wedderburn block of H_3 specifically. That requires: (a) substrate-level implementation of QCD color-singlet (Fermi-statistics → sign rep), and (b) categorical Wedderburn-projection of the EM coupling. Neither exists yet at the categorical level — this is the actual multi-session open work behind ProtonMassEMSignBlock.

caveats: Test 2's printed line 'full at q_0 gives 1.16' is wrong: the line above it prints the same quantity as 1.09417312281712097, and assertion em_shape_departure_from_unity_at_q0 measures the departure as 0.0941731228, i.e. the shape is 1.0942 at q_0, not 1.16. The printed 1.16 has no route in this module. Reported rather than silently corrected.
